title: cirsium falconeri var. horrida
intro: Cirsium falconeri var. horrida, commonly known as a species of thistle, is a flowering plant that belongs to the family Asteraceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its health benefits, including its ability to support the immune system and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Cirsium falconeri var. horrida include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer properties.
